notes: BUB1B compound heterozygous - mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 1 (MIM 257300, ORPHA:1052). c.2210T>G p.Leu737Ter (ClinVar Pathogenic/Likely_pathogenic for MVA1; gnomAD gAF 3.3e-05; PTC 748nt upstream of the final exon junction so NMD predicted; truncates 29 residues before the kinase domain begins) in trans with c.3006T>G p.Asn1002Lys (1 allele in 1461878 gnomAD v4 exomes, AF 6.8e-07, absent from genomes and dbSNP; AlphaMissense 0.923, MVP 0.852; inside the kinase domain, UniProt O60566 766-1050). Null plus hypomorph is the MVA1 configuration - biallelic truncating BUB1B is not viable. Exomiser 15.1.0 given only the 8 HPO terms and sex, with no gene panel, ranks this pair first of 363 genes under AUTOSOMAL_RECESSIVE.
BUB1B c.2210T>G p.Leu737Ter alone, in case the answer key pairs this allele with a variant this pipeline did not call.
BUB1B c.3006T>G p.Asn1002Lys alone, for the same reason. Note c.3006T>A reaches the identical p.Asn1002Lys substitution and is already a ClinVar VUS.

LZTR1 c.2244C>G p.Tyr748Ter, heterozygous, ClinVar Pathogenic/Likely_pathogenic, SpliceAI 0.92. Actionable incidental finding: heterozygous LZTR1 loss of function predisposes to schwannomatosis. Unrelated to the primary phenotype but worth surfacing clinically.

FANCD2 c.1278+1del and c.1278+3_1278+5del - the chromosomal-instability differential, and Exomiser's rank-3 gene. Submitted as a considered alternative rather than a belief: ClinVar classifies both alleles Benign, and Exomiser's own ACMG engine applies PVS1 to a variant ClinVar has already called benign.
RBM8A 5' UTR variant, heterozygous, ClinVar Pathogenic/Likely_pathogenic low penetrance. Recessive carrier finding for TAR syndrome.
GNRHR c.416G>A p.Arg139His, heterozygous, ClinVar Pathogenic. Carrier state for autosomal-recessive hypogonadotropic hypogonadism; no second allele found.
